verdict.rationale: iTerm2 documents a custom escape sequence for displaying images, including animated GIFs, inline in the terminal, and ships imgcat as a client for it. Community users corroborate that it works over SSH, renders matplotlib plots inline, and accepts base64-encoded image data prepended with the escape sequence. missing for 10: an in-depth protocol specification in the evidence (only a one-line mention of the escape sequence), and imgcat is not installed by default.
